conditionalTypes.WebPage: Requires verified production origin and canonical URL.
conditionalTypes.ImageObject: Requires verified absolute public image URL.
conditionalTypes.Place: Use only for a distinct place entity; omit when Restaurant already represents the same physical location.

prohibitedTypes.AggregateRating: No verified aggregate review count and rating source is approved for schema.
prohibitedTypes.Review: Visible review text has not been independently verified for publication as schema.
prohibitedTypes.Offer: No verified prices, currency, availability, or offer URLs.
prohibitedTypes.Product: Restaurant dishes are modeled as MenuItem unless a real product-commerce use case is approved.
prohibitedTypes.FAQPage: Not recommended for Google rich-result benefit on this commercial restaurant site; no automatic FAQ schema.

rules: Only VERIFIED source fields may enter production-eligible previews.
Unknown required production fields block integration.
No placeholders are emitted as data values.
Big Tokyo is excluded until its availability contradiction is resolved.
WebSite, WebPage, public @id, canonical URL, and ImageObject are omitted until their absolute URLs are verified.
Do not duplicate Restaurant with Organization or a Place node for the same physical entity.
